method: Read-only parsing and exact original-assessor recomputation; no Flutter/build/native run was launched by this evidence pass. No raw records or budgets were changed.
time_zone: Asia/Shanghai (UTC+08:00); raw epoch and UTC times also retained.

measured_process_rss.scope: Whole instrumented process during measured interactions; sampled peaks may miss shorter spikes. This gate cannot establish component allocation cost or absence of leaks.

interpretation: These are explicit engineering defaults, not official Flutter thresholds or a user-approved product budget.
Frame percentiles use nearest rank and the complete independent FrameTiming arrays, not bounded VM timeline retention.
Build and raster stages are assessed separately because rendering is pipelined; totalSpan includes scheduling and is not a count of displayed dropped frames.
The fixed measured-process RSS limits are a desktop harness risk gate; component memory and leak assessment remain unassessed even when it passes.
One passing observed run does not establish repeat-run stability or acceptance on other devices, platforms, accessibility configurations or physical input.

source_integrity.scope_note: Acceptance checks the listed build/runtime inputs and git revision. Changes to out-of-scope documentation/tests are reported by worktree status and do not alter this manifest.

source.whole_worktree_claim: No clean-worktree claim; this verifies only the recorded build/runtime input scope.

runtime.legacy_metadata_note: locale and semantics_enabled retain the historical platform-dispatcher meaning; widget locale and framework Semantics are recorded independently.

renderer.observation_status: Not exposed by the Flutter public runtime API; inspect the saved engine launch log.

native_preparation.observation_note: Readiness requires observed resumed lifecycle, frame progression and stable geometry/semantics flags after explicit Start. It is preparation evidence, not measured frame timing or independent proof of window visibility.

scenarios.assessment_scope: Per-scenario diagnostic using unchanged original assessor; this does not override aggregate run validity.

native_environment_during_measurement.observation_note: Lifecycle and metrics use native binding events. The original frame and memory samples are retained when any observation invalidates the run.

host_sidecar.timestamp_basis: Raw top timestamps have no offset; UTC interpretation follows the root capture context and native epoch alignment. Local rendering is Asia/Shanghai UTC+08:00.
host_sidecar.privacy: Raw sidecar retained without reproducing process command lines or personal media names.
host_sidecar.interpretation: Coverage is not CPU/GPU causality. No CPU or contention conclusion is made outside the saved interval.
